sources.snippet: Olmo 3 7B RL-Zero Mix is a language model with 7B parameters developed by Allen AI, belonging to the Olmo 3 series. This model was pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset, post-trained on the Dolci dataset, and optimized for mathematical, coding, and reasoning abilities through reinforcement learning.
